session.transport: GitHub Actions artifacts from two manually dispatched runs of pq-sequoia-macos.yml
session.rule: The macOS secret certificate exists only in the original running macOS job. The peer response must arrive before that job exits; no later job may resume decryption.

reject a locally altered message

secret_lifetime.location: one GitHub-hosted macOS runner temporary directory
secret_lifetime.cleanup_after: macos-ci-close succeeds or the job exits

reject a locally altered message

reject a locally tampered ciphertext with no recovered output
encrypt message.bin to the macOS public certificate
publish hatchery-phase-c.json through the peer-response workflow mode
record cleanup of the retained Hatchery disposable secret material

inputs: the still-running macOS job's local disposable secret certificate
operations: decrypt ciphertext-to-macos-ci.pgp and compare all 51 message bytes
reject a locally tampered ciphertext with no recovered output

secret_lifetime.location: one GitHub-hosted macOS runner temporary directory

artifact_policy.revocation_transfer_decision: Do not transfer revocation packets. Each peer exercises emergency certificate, explicit retired certificate, retired signing-subkey, and retired encryption-subkey transitions locally; only value-free result classifications, packet SHA-256 values, sizes, and scrubbed diagnostics enter its result JSON.

failure_semantics.identity_or_digest_mismatch: reject the session without invoking an unqualified shared command path
failure_semantics.relay_timeout: reject the incomplete session and clean both local secret workspaces; never resume with a new macOS job
failure_semantics.operation_failure: retain only value-free failure classification and scrubbed diagnostics, then clean local secret material
failure_semantics.rollback: disable the candidate workflow; there is no accepted earlier macOS CI closure

identity_binding.rule: Every envelope uses the same session_id and message_sha256. Each producer keeps one candidate_identity for every phase it emits; the macOS close rejects a Hatchery candidate_identity that differs from the opening phase.
identity_binding.payload_rule: Payload maps and result maps are closed schemas. Every payload record is base64 with an exact decoded size and lowercase SHA-256; extra envelope, payload, or result fields are rejected.

required_observations: both peers verify the other's detached signature with exact sqv
both peers reject tampered ciphertext with no recovered output
both peers exercise certificate and subkey revocation locally
both peers report matching transferred-artifact SHA-256 values and sizes
both peers report local secret cleanup complete
